# GROUP A: A single tall ascender stroke, looped or thickened at the top and descending to a short foot or a join at the base: the cursive letter "l", or one "l" of a doubled "ll".
# GROUP B: A two-part cipher sign. On the left is a closed or angular "4"/"q"-like head with a long vertical stem that drops below the line. On the right is a "3"-like double bow ("43").
# GROUP C: A two-part cipher sign. On the left is an open "c"/"o"-like bowl. On the right is a stacked double loop like an "8", and a long vertical stem runs down through them below the line ("φ8").
